newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian, Dutch egg firms form new group.
newsitem.headline: Belgian, Dutch egg firms form new group.

text.p: Egg-product makers Dion Vandewiele SA of Belgium and Van den Burg from the Netherlands have agreed to work together and unite in a new holding company, Dion said in a statement.
Van den Burg is part of the Cehave group based in Veghel.
The combined operation would have total capacity of about 10 million eggs a day, with an annual turnover of about three billion Belgian francs, the statement said.
"The combination of the two companies will create a very strong position in the European egg-product industry," it added.
